Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F03
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: Every repository access path reflects current organizational authority, with explainable effective access.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Replace permanent curator bypass with governed stewardship and enforce principal disablement, membership removal and grant expiry transactionally.
2. Apply authority to directory listings/counts, dataset/release reads, queries, preparations, acceptance/retries/receipts, downloads and run input/destination use; preserve bounded disclosure and fixed-release semantics.
3. Add authorized effective-access inspection and negative fixtures for cross-lab leakage, independent grants, concurrent policy changes and stale contexts; ensure continuing delivery rechecks the declared policy bound.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
